feeds.title: LGBTQ Music Chart
feeds.description: Find trending gay artists, songs, videos & news from around the world. LGBTQ Music Chart is a music chart for the LGBTQ community and their family and friends around the world.

feeds.title: The Q Blog
feeds.description: Read artist interviews, release features, reviews, introduction spotlights, new releases, topical content, and much more. The Q utilizes media as a means to elevate the voices of our global queer creative community.

feeds.title: Philadelphia Gay News » Music
feeds.description: Philadelphia Gay News' Music section talks about soothing and savage new releases and artists. Founded in 1976, Philadelphia Gay News provides a platform for education and conversation about the issues impacting the LGBT community.

feeds.title: Washington Blade » Music & Concerts
feeds.description: Washington Blade is America's Leading LGBT music & concert news source. The oldest LGBTQ newspaper in the U.S. covers the latest gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender news in Washington, DC, and around the world.

feeds.title: OutSmart Magazine » Music
feeds.description: OutSmart Magazine is Houston's premier LGBTQ+ music media source. Now publishing in our 25th year, OutSmart is the Houston-based magazine edited for the lesbian, gay bisexual, and transgender audience.

feeds.title: Gay Men's Chorus of South Florida Blog
feeds.description: Gather news announcements and the latest tour and vents details from the Gay Men's Chorus of South Florida. GMCSF brings live music and entertainment to the community through large-scale, main-stage concerts in high-profile venues, community-based engagements, and volunteer projects.

feeds.title: PinkNews » Music
feeds.description: The latest LGBT pop music news, interviews, and updates from PinkNews. Get the album and single release dates, tour dates, and fan reaction for LGBT singers. PinkNews covers politics, entertainment, religion, and community news for the gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender community in the UK and worldwide.

feeds.title: LGBTQ+ Music Study Group Blog
feeds.description: Read articles discussing the history and rise of Queer Musicology and its growing culture. LGBTQ+ Music Study Group is an initiative dedicated to create a safe space and support system for LGBTQ+ people within the scholarly community. The Group's mission is to promote and support academic inquiry into issues of gender and sexuality in the study of music.

feeds.title: Autostraddle » Music
feeds.description: Autostraddle's Music Section is a vibrant hub for queer and trans music enthusiasts, offering a diverse array of content that celebrates LGBTQ+ artists and their contributions to the music industry.

feeds.title: Diva Magazine » Music
feeds.description: DIVA brings you the latest in lesbian and bi-related celebrity interviews, news, politics, pop culture, style, travel, social issues, and entertainment. Also tackle the tough topics, like racism in the LGBTQI community, mental health, and the challenges facing queer youth, and profile inspirational women who are making a difference in the lives of lesbian, bi, and trans women.

feeds.title: GAY45 » Music
feeds.description: GAY45 Music is a European queer magazine that offers in-depth commentary and critique on contemporary music, focusing on LGBTQ+ artists and themes. The publication provides thoughtful analysis of pop culture, exploring how music intersects with identity, politics, and societal issues.

feeds.title: IN THE KEY OF Q
feeds.description: In the Key of Q is a dynamic platform dedicated to amplifying LGBTQ+ voices in the music industry. Through its podcast and blog, the site offers in-depth interviews, personal narratives, and cultural analyses that explore the intersections of music, identity, and community.

feeds.title: Focus LGBT+ Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Home of the Blues and eclectic sounds from Queer artists and more.

feeds.title: Tad's Weekly LGBT Music Charts
feeds.description: Proudly celebrating LGBT musicians. (Not just at Pride, but all year long.) Tad isn't my real name. It's just a childhood nickname that I'm using here. I've been creating my own music charts since the 1980s.

feeds.title: EQ Music Blog
feeds.description: EQ Music Blog is the authority on new electronic pop and alternative music with daily updates, news, music videos, and interviews with the most relevant names in pop music. Their mission is to promote and foster the development of new pop and electronic music through online publishing, live events, and social media. Browse their blog and learn more about updates, news, music videos, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Charlie Rogers Blog
feeds.description: Blogs featuring the latest news, updates, sneak peeks, and personal musings from Charlie Rogers. Discover his upcoming and recently released music, travel blogs, and more. Charlie Rogers is an Oregon-born, Kansas-raised genre-alchemizing country singer-songwriter based out of Nashville, TN.

feeds.title: Diversity Choir
feeds.description: London's original lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender community chamber choir.

feeds.title: SHOUTS » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Explore how 1980s Yugoslav rock bands addressed same-sex love through music, revealing the power of love amidst societal secrecy.

feeds.title: Gayety » Music
feeds.description: At Gayety, we celebrate the rich tapestry of LGBTQ+ music by spotlighting both iconic and emerging queer artists. Our coverage includes in-depth profiles of openly gay musicians, festivals, performances, and more.

feeds.title: OUT FRONT » Music
feeds.description: OUT FRONT is the nation's second-oldest queer media company. We are dedicated to providing news and features content to and about LGBTQ folks, both in Colorado and worldwide. We believe every person and culture is a worthy and vibrant contribution to the fabric of humanity. We are committed to providing the LGBT community and their friends a powerful media platform to educate, celebrate, and activate that belief.

feeds.title: Out in STL » Music
feeds.description: Out in STL Music is a dynamic platform celebrating the vibrant queer music scene in St. Louis. The site offers a blend of artist spotlights, event coverage, and cultural commentary, highlighting both local talents and national icons within the LGBTQ+ community.

feeds.title: Dallas Voice » Music
feeds.description: Dallas Voice Music is a prominent LGBTQ+ media outlet in North Texas, offering comprehensive coverage of queer music and arts. Their music section, updated regularly, provides a blend of artist spotlights, event coverage, and cultural commentary, highlighting both local talents and national icons within the LGBTQ+ community.

feeds.title: KET MAG Brussels » Music
feeds.description: Our city is a creative hub welcoming artists from around the world, and also home to some of the most exciting performers that you'll find anywhere. Join us as we discover the best of the music scene in Brussels.

feeds.title: San Francisco Bay Times » Music
feeds.description: The San Francisco Bay Times' Music section offers a rich tapestry of LGBTQ+ musical culture, spotlighting both legendary and emerging artists, as well as significant events that celebrate queer musical heritage in the Bay Area and beyond.

feeds.title: AfterEllen » Music
feeds.description: Read news and updates on music written by the experts of AfterEllen. AfterEllen.com provides a fun, feminist perspective for lesbian and bisexual women with an emphasis on: daily breaking news, reviews, interviews, recaps, commentary and more.

feeds.title: Gay Music Chart Blog
feeds.description: Gay Music Chart is the LGBTQA-related music video Top 50 actuality and most requested.

feeds.title: Mary Lambert Blog
feeds.description: New. updates, personal stories, and thoughts from queer singer-songwriter-poet, Mary Lambert. Mary talk about her on-going and upcoming projects, direct thoughts and observations and more interesting insights in her blog.

feeds.title: Gay Times » Music
feeds.description: All the latest LGBTQ+ music news from Gay Times. Features trending music stories, opinions, and interviews with your favorite queer artists. Gay Times has been a vital resource for the LGBTQ community since its genesis in 1974.

feeds.title: Country Queer
feeds.description: Country Queer is a platform Lifting up LGBTQ+ voices in the country and Americana. This is a space where we can be ourselves: proudly queer, and proud fans of down-home music. We publish this website, with extensive coverage of queer country, folk, and Americana artists, and other issues of interest to country queers.

feeds.title: GLAAD » Music
feeds.description: Stories about singers, groups, bands, and musical acts who have something to say about the LGBT community, good or bad. GLAAD rewrites the script for LGBTQ acceptance. GLAAD tackles tough issues to shape the narrative and provoke dialogue that leads to cultural change and protects all that has been accomplished.
